> **Native rendering stability fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.1)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.1 incorporates m151 GPU, font-rendering, and shader stability fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Upstream Ganesh and text stability** — Includes failed-flush and stale-readback fixes, an Imagination framebuffer workaround, Fontations bitmap-strike selection, and SkSL map-pointer corrections without changing managed APIs. ([#4667](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4667))
